# BAROWO

> BAROWO is a mobile bar and bartending service from Gdynia, Poland. It serves weddings, birthdays (including 18th birthdays), corporate events and private parties in Trójmiasto (Gdynia, Gdańsk, Sopot) and the Pomorskie region, up to about 150 km from Gdynia. Full service starts from 3000 PLN, and alcohol is included in every package.

Primary website: https://barowo.com/
Language of the website: Polish

## Key facts

- Service: full mobile bar service. The bar, bartenders, glassware, alcohol, cocktail ingredients, menu and service at the event are all included.
- Price: from 3000 PLN (pełna obsługa od 3000 zł). The final quote depends on the number of guests, date, location and package.
- Service time: Simple package up to 6 hours, Standard and Premium up to 8 hours. In every package the bar can stay longer for extra hours.
- Area: Gdynia, Gdańsk, Sopot, Trójmiasto and Pomorskie, up to about 150 km from Gdynia. Longer trips are agreed individually.
- Address: Stryjska 13, Gdynia, Poland.
- Team: Artem (head bartender), Ivan (bartender and client contact).
- Extra: chocolate fountain (fontanna czekoladowa), available as an add-on or a separate service. It is included in the Premium package.

## Packages

- Simple: 1 bartender, Modern mobile bar, vodka, rum and prosecco, 7 cocktails, up to 6 hours of service.
- Standard: 2 bartenders, Modern or Boho bar, additionally whiskey and Aperol, 8 cocktails and 3 non-alcoholic drinks, free tasting, up to 8 hours of service.
- Premium: 2 bartenders, Modern or Boho bar, premium spirits (including gin, Cointreau, Campari, vermouth), 15 cocktails and 6 non-alcoholic drinks. It also includes a welcome drink, a glass tower, a chocolate fountain and a free tasting. Up to 8 hours of service.
